atlas_fit.current_problem: Atlas provider routing must account for product tier, training defaults, retention, logging, location, and protected-data class—not price alone.
atlas_fit.future_risk: The word free, local, API, business, or zero retention may be treated as a universal privacy guarantee.

claims.claim: Official provider policies distinguish consumer and commercial data use, opt-in training, retention, logging, and zero-data-retention conditions.
Any provider or plan is universally safe for protected Atlas data.

excluded_classes: raw financial, legal, tax, insurance, mortgage, estate, brokerage, or account evidence

unresolved: Runtime behavior, security effectiveness, performance, and compatibility were not independently executed or benchmarked in this Mission.
